Hi Michael, I’m Jon Clark, and I’m interested in the 2016 Nissan Altima you have listed. Before we move forward, I want to address the asking price and get a clear picture of the vehicle's mechanical history.

Your $12,600 asking price sits above the current KBB private-party range ($10,990–$12,540) and the estimated market average of $11,765. To justify pricing it above market, I’d need to see strong documentation of its condition and upkeep.

With 83,223 miles on the odometer, could you provide complete maintenance records? Specifically, I need details on CVT transmission service, fluid & filter changes, brakes, tires, suspension components, and whether there have been any oil consumption/leak issues, warning lights, or recurring problems. Nissan CVTs can be costly if neglected, so I want to be transparent upfront.

Based on current market data, I’m anchoring my initial offer around $9,500, but I’m open to adjusting upward depending on what the service records and a pre-purchase inspection reveal. Please send over the maintenance history and any recent repair receipts, and I’ll review everything carefully.

Most importantly, if they come back with $10k+, I can just slam <DEAL_REACHED>. No need to haggle further over small amounts. Seller said "don't be play hardball over couple hundred".
